agency_profiles_logo_ck.name: agency_profiles_logo_ck
agency_profiles_logo_ck.value: ("agency_profiles"."logo_storage_key" is null and "agency_profiles"."logo_content_type" is null and "agency_profiles"."logo_size_bytes" is null) or (starts_with("agency_profiles"."logo_storage_key", 'agency-logos/' || "agency_profiles"."agency_id"::text || '/') and "agency_profiles"."logo_content_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp') and "agency_profiles"."logo_size_bytes" > 0)

agency_profiles_colors_ck.name: agency_profiles_colors_ck
agency_profiles_colors_ck.value: ("agency_profiles"."primary_color" is null or "agency_profiles"."primary_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$') and ("agency_profiles"."accent_color" is null or "agency_profiles"."accent_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')

agency_settings_commission_ck.name: agency_settings_commission_ck
agency_settings_commission_ck.value: ("agency_settings"."default_commission_type" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_bp" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_fixed_cents" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_currency" is null) or ("agency_settings"."default_commission_type" = 'PCT' and "agency_settings"."default_commission_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "agency_settings"."default_commission_fixed_cents" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_currency" is null) or ("agency_settings"."default_commission_type" = 'FIXED' and "agency_settings"."default_commission_bp" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_fixed_cents" between 1 and 100000000000 and "agency_settings"."default_commission_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

agency_translations_length_ck.name: agency_translations_length_ck
agency_translations_length_ck.value: ("agency_translations"."tagline" is null or char_length("agency_translations"."tagline") <= 160) and ("agency_translations"."description" is null or char_length("agency_translations"."description") <= 5000)

agency_invites_open_email_uq.name: agency_invites_open_email_uq
agency_invites_open_email_uq.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null
